rows.text: Read the ordered pair (a, b). Compute the sum of the two values.
Read the ordered pair (a, b). Return the total value.
Gooo activity Decide(Integer) -> Integer. Intent: 입력 순서는 첫 값=a, 다음 값=b이다. 두 수를 더한 결과를 산출하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: 피연산자는 a, b이다. 두 값을 합산한 결과를 내라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: Use a as the first input; use b as the second. Find the first value after taking away the second.
Operands: x, y. Return the ordered difference.
Gooo activity Decide(Integer) -> Integer. Intent: 피연산자는 x, y이다. 입력 순서를 반영한 차이를 반환하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: 입력 순서는 첫 값=x, 다음 값=y이다. 첫 번째 수에서 두 번째 수를 제거한 값을 내라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: Use x as the first input; use y as the second. Use the second as a repeated scale factor for the first.
Inputs are left=left; right=right. Return the product of the values.
Gooo activity Decide(Integer) -> Integer. Intent: 순서가 있는 입력 (left, right)을 읽어라. 두 수를 곱한 결과를 계산하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: left를 첫 입력으로, right를 다음 입력으로 사용하라. 두 입력의 곱셈 결과를 산출하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: Use left as the first input; use right as the second. Check if the first lies below the second.
Operands: first, second. Return whether the first value is strictly smaller.
Gooo activity Decide(Integer) -> Boolean. Intent: first를 첫 입력으로, second를 다음 입력으로 사용하라. 첫 값이 다음 값보다 엄격히 작은지 답하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: first를 첫 입력으로, second를 다음 입력으로 사용하라. 첫 값의 크기가 더 낮은지 판정하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: Read the ordered pair (first, second). Decide whether the first is no greater than the second.
Read the ordered pair (m, n). Check if the first is at most the second.
Gooo activity Decide(Integer) -> Boolean. Intent: 순서가 있는 입력 (m, n)을 읽어라. 첫 값이 다음 값보다 크지 않은지 답하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: 입력 순서는 첫 값=m, 다음 값=n이다. 첫 입력이 두 번째 입력 이하인지 표시하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: Use m as the first input; use n as the second. Check if both values are identical.
Operands: p, q. Decide whether their numeric values coincide.
Gooo activity Decide(Integer) -> Boolean. Intent: 순서가 있는 입력 (p, q)을 읽어라. 두 값이 정확히 같은지 답하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: 피연산자는 p, q이다. 두 값이 정확히 같은지 답하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: Conditions are first=feature_p; next=feature_q. The result is true when every condition holds.
Conditions are first=signal_a; next=signal_b. Mark true if both flags are true.
Gooo activity Decide(Boolean) -> Boolean. Intent: signal_a를 첫 플래그로, signal_b를 다음 플래그로 사용하라. 각 불리언 입력이 모두 참일 때만 참을 반환하라.
PROV-O: compiler activity uses an intent entity and generates an IR entity. Required behavior: signal_a를 첫 플래그로, signal_b를 다음 플래그로 사용하라. 입력 중 하나라도 거짓이면 거짓을 반환하라.
